admission.justification: Prevents a successor losing its durable applied identity or resetting the sealed review allowance.

applicability: The applied role-seat transition recorded for an admitted stepped-up start and its later exact-request reconciliation.
conditions: Record the applied destination and step-up origin durably without replacing unrelated human decisions.
Keep sealed findings, round counters and approval limits unchanged; retries preserve the saved request/choice identity.
exclusions: A task decision is not acceptance or a new review allowance.
No migration/backfill of underway historical memory reviews.
statement: The product durably records the applied seat transition and reports its origin without resetting review findings, rounds or approval limits.
